A simple place to begin

What do Christians mean by the good news?

Christians believe God made people to know Him. Sin harms that relationship and brings real separation. The good news is that Jesus died and rose again to bring forgiveness and new life. Christians receive this as a gift by trusting Him—not by earning it through good behavior.

Read more: Romans 3:23 · Romans 5:8 · Romans 10:9–10

Action · Worship · Encourage

Spreading Christ, one mission at a time.

AWE Missions is a family-led mobile missionary effort that shares the love of Jesus through community and practical service. We hope to meet needs with food, clothing, shelter connections, Bibles, and encouragement.

“Go therefore and make disciples of all nations...” Matthew 28:19
